findings.claim: FY2023–FY2025 三年均無單一客戶占營收超過 10%，且 2024、2025 年底無客戶占應收帳款超過 10%。
findings.excerpt: For the years ended December 31, 2025, 2024 and 2023 no customer accounted for more than 10% of revenue. As of December 31, 2025 and 2024, no customer accounted for more than 10% of accounts receivable.

findings.claim: 風險因素仍揭露營收來自有限數量客戶，失去或大幅減少主要客戶業務將對營收造成重大不利影響。
findings.excerpt: We generate a significant amount of our revenue from a limited number of customers. However, our customers may not continue to utilize our products or services at current levels, pricing, or at all, and our revenue could fluctuate significantly
